program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (sp-color (find-first (lambda (v) (and (!= v 0) (!= v 1) (!= v 4)))
                                      (grid-colors g)))
                (sp-cells (find-color g sp-color))
                (r0 (min-of first sp-cells))
                (r1 (max-of first sp-cells))
                (c0 (min-of second sp-cells))
                (c1 (max-of second sp-cells))
                (th (/ (+ 1 (- r1 r0)) 2))
                (tw (/ (+ 1 (- c1 c0)) 2))
                (rstarts (range 0 h 4))
                (cstarts (range 0 w 4)))
           (define (block-on? tr tc)
             (for/or ((dr (range 0 2)))
                     (for/or ((dc (range 0 2)))
                             (= (at g (+ r0 (* tr 2) dr) (+ c0 (* tc 2) dc)) sp-color))))
           (define template
             (filter (lambda (p) (block-on? (first p) (second p)))
                     (flatmap (lambda (tr)
                                (map (lambda (tc) (list tr tc)) (range 0 tw)))
                              (range 0 th))))
           (define (contains-template? rs cs)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (let* ((r (+ rs (first p)))
                            (c (+ cs (second p))))
                       (and (< r h) (< c w) (= (at g r c) 1))))
                   template))
           (reduce (lambda (acc rs)
                     (reduce (lambda (a cs)
                               (if (contains-template? rs cs)
                                   (reduce (lambda (aa p)
                                             (set-cell aa
                                                       (+ rs (first p))
                                                       (+ cs (second p))
                                                       sp-color))
                                           a
                                           template)
                                   a))
                             acc
                             cstarts))
                   g
                   rstarts))))
